name: Supply Summary for WooCommerce
author: Armin Jamali

sections.description:
Supply Summary for WooCommerce helps store owners, warehouse teams, and production staff quickly understand what products need to be prepared based on active WooCommerce orders.

Instead of reviewing orders one by one, the plugin creates a consolidated supply report showing the total quantity required for each product and variation. Products are automatically grouped by category, making it easier to organize production, inventory preparation, and order fulfillment.

Whether you manufacture products on demand, prepare inventory daily, or need a picking list for warehouse operations, this plugin provides a clear overview of what needs to be supplied.

Features

  • Aggregate quantities from multiple WooCommerce orders
  • Display total required quantity per product
  • Support for variable products and variations
  • Group products by category
  • Date range filtering
  • Jalali (Shamsi) calendar support
  • Gregorian calendar support
  • Print-friendly reports
  • Lightweight and easy to use
  • No external CDN dependencies

Ideal For

  • Manufacturing businesses
  • Print-on-demand stores
  • Apparel and clothing shops
  • Food and bakery businesses
  • Workshops and handmade products
  • Warehouse operations
  • Order fulfillment teams
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin files to the /wp-content/plugins/ directory.
  2. Activate the plugin through the WordPress Plugins screen.
  3. Ensure WooCommerce is installed and activated.
  4. Open the Supply Summary menu in the WordPress admin area.
  5. Generate and print supply reports as needed.
sections.faq:
Does this plugin require WooCommerce?

Yes. WooCommerce must be installed and active.

Which order statuses are included?

By default the report includes:

  • Processing
  • On Hold
  • Pending

Does it support product variations?

Yes. Product variations are fully supported and displayed separately.

Can I filter results by date?

Yes. You can generate reports for specific date ranges.

Can I print the report?

Yes. The report is optimized for printing.

Does it support Jalali dates?

Yes. Jalali (Shamsi) calendars are supported for Persian-language admin environments.
